decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-186 MODIFY recording that domain reassignment alone is insufficient and that settings and subscriptions are account-bound; no additional edit is required.
Account-bound settings and subscriptions explain why moving a domain does not resolve the site mix-up, but they do not change the requirement that each location have its own website.
The source says domain reassignment alone cannot resolve the broader account and content problem; it does not change the intended master domain or domain-to-website association.
The account-bound configuration fact does not alter the capability, template strategy, or redesign constraint for adding future locations.
The source does not change which locations appear on the master site or how visitors select and navigate to a location.
Although Wix account settings and subscriptions are account-bound, the source does not specifically change booking placement, booking isolation, or Ridgehaven booking activation.
The source does not mention or change staff access controls; account-bound settings alone do not entail a new staff-access rule.
The source does not change the requirement for separate payouts or the existing account and payment setup supporting that isolation.
The source does not specifically change analytics, reporting placement, or separate revenue and sales tracking.
The account-bound configuration statement does not change the requirement that each location maintain its own calendar.
The source does not mention customer data or change Ridgehaven's customer-database isolation requirement.
The source does not specifically address gift cards or alter their required operational isolation.
